name: train-only-repair-strength-pilot
selection: First two alphabetically sorted gate-eligible intents in each TRAIN stream; fixed before repair observations.
actions: Same fresh AdamW target-only, balanced-old+new, none, restore and sham actions as main study. No trained lens and no predictor fitting.
gate: Same predeclared repair_feasibility criterion. Four TRAIN intents total must produce >=2 meaningful responses plus variation before full lens/repair study. No heldout-intent actions or labels inspected.
followup: If the pilot fails, retain the failed receipt and use separately sealed configs/prospective-repair64.json for a new pilot. Do not dispatch the full study with a failed pilot.
reuse: After pilot passes, the main measurement may reuse these exact action records while computing its own pre-action features from immutable acquired/forgotten checkpoints. Support/optimizer/schedule/checkpoint identities must match; no extra learner training occurs to tune features.
scope: Feasibility of repairing learned CLINC intent-to-code bindings; neither a semantic erasure claim nor a predictive result.
